This is sand leveling, or topdressing. It creates a more level surface for your lawn by filling in low areas. I use masonry sand since I have Bermuda grass. If you have a cool season grass type, a screened topsoil may be better. I like to put a little fertilizer down prior to, and after to ensure bermuda is growing aggressively through the sand. I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! Perfect for anyone wanting professional landscaping results on a DIY budget. ✨ 🛠️ MATERIALS: • Retaining wall blocks • Cap stones • Landscape fabric • Quality topsoil • Evergreen shrubs (boxwood) • Purple flowering plants • Black mulch • Solar landscape lights ⏱️ TIME: 1 day 💰 BUDGET: $250-400 🔧 SKILL LEVEL: Beginner 📋 STEPS: 1. Mark curved design in lawn 2. Excavate area 4-6 inches deep 3. Stack retaining wall blocks 4. Add cap stones on top 5. Install landscape fabric 6. Fill with quality topsoil 7.
